Fixpoint mapM {A B : Type} (f : A -> option B) (l : list A) : option (list B) :=
  match l with
  | [] => Some []
  | x :: xs =>
      match f x, mapM f xs with
      | Some y, Some ys => Some (y :: ys)
      | _, _ => None
      end
  end.

Definition static_getType_list (sΓ: s_env): list Loc -> option (list qualified_type) :=
  fun l => mapM (fun x => static_getType sΓ x) l.

Definition runtime_lookup_list (rΓ: r_env): list Loc -> option (list value) :=
  fun l => mapM (fun x => runtime_getVal rΓ x) l.

Fixpoint forallb2 {A B} (f : A -> B -> bool) (l1 : list A) (l2 : list B) : bool :=
  match l1, l2 with
  | [], [] => true
  | x1 :: xs1, x2 :: xs2 => f x1 x2 && forallb2 f xs1 xs2
  | _, _ => false
  end.

Fixpoint update {X : Type} (position : nat) (value : X) (l : list X) : list X :=
  match l, position with
  | [], _ => []
  | _::t, 0 => value :: t
  | h::l', S n => h :: update n value l'
  end.

Notation "[ x ↦  v ] l" := (update x v l) (at level 0).

  match rΓ with
  {| vars := vars; |} =>

Inductive reachable (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> Prop :=

  | rch_heap : forall l
      (Hdom : l < dom h),
      reachable h l l

  | rch_step : forall l0 l1 obj f
      (Hdom    : l1 < dom h)
      (Hobj    : runtime_getObj h l0 = Some obj)
      (Hfield  : getVal obj.(fields_map) f = Some (Iot l1)),
      reachable h l0 l1

  | rch_trans : forall l0 l1 l2
      (Hreach1 : reachable h l0 l1)
      (Hreach2 : reachable h l1 l2),
      reachable h l0 l2.

Definition heap_edge (h : heap) (l0 l1 : Loc) : Prop :=
  exists obj f,
    runtime_getObj h l0 = Some obj /\
    getVal obj.(fields_map) f = Some (Iot l1) /\
    l1 < dom h.

Inductive edge_path (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> list Loc -> Prop :=
  | edge_path_nil : forall l,
      edge_path h l l []
  | edge_path_cons : forall l0 l1 l2 nodes,
      heap_edge h l0 l1 ->
      edge_path h l1 l2 nodes ->
      edge_path h l0 l2 (l1 :: nodes).

Fixpoint reachable_in (h : heap) (fuel : nat) (l0 l1 : Loc) : Prop :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => l0 = l1
  | S fuel' =>
      l0 = l1 \/
      exists next, heap_edge h l0 next /\ reachable_in h fuel' next l1
  end.

Inductive reachable_abs (CT : class_table) (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> Prop :=

  | reachable_abs_heap : forall l
      (Hdom : l < dom h),
      reachable_abs CT h l l

  | reachable_abs_step : forall l0 l1 any C vals k
      (Hdom        : l1 < dom h)
      (Hobj        : runtime_getObj h l0 = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type any C) vals))
      (Hfield      : nth_error vals k = Some (Iot l1))
      (Hmut_abs    : sf_mutability_rel CT C k RDM_f \/ sf_mutability_rel CT C k Imm_f)
      (Hassign_abs : sf_assignability_rel CT C k RDA \/ sf_assignability_rel CT C k Final),
      reachable_abs CT h l0 l1

  | reachable_abs_trans : forall l0 l1 l2
      (Hreach1 : reachable_abs CT h l0 l1)
      (Hreach2 : reachable_abs CT h l1 l2),
      reachable_abs CT h l0 l2.

Definition protected_locset
  (CT : class_table) (h : heap) (l_root : Loc) : Ensembles.Ensemble Loc :=
  fun l_target => reachable_abs CT h l_root l_target.

Inductive CollectFields : class_table -> class_name -> list field_def -> Prop :=

  | CF_NotFound : forall CT C
      (Hnone : find_class CT C = None),
      CollectFields CT C []


  | CF_Object : forall CT C def
      (Hfind  : find_class CT C = Some def)
      (Hsuper : super (signature def) = None),
      CollectFields CT C []


  | CF_Inherit : forall CT C def parent parent_fields own_fields
      (Hfind        : find_class CT C = Some def)
      (Hsuper       : super (signature def) = Some parent)
      (Hparent_cf   : CollectFields CT parent parent_fields)
      (Hown_fields  : own_fields = Syntax.fields (body def)),
      CollectFields CT C (parent_fields ++ own_fields).

Inductive FieldLookup : class_table -> class_name -> var -> field_def -> Prop :=
  | FL_Found : forall CT C fields f fdef
      (Hcf  : CollectFields CT C fields)
      (Hget : gget fields f = Some fdef),
      FieldLookup CT C f fdef.

Definition sf_def_rel (CT: class_table) (C: class_name) (f: var) (fdef: field_def) : Prop :=
  FieldLookup CT C f fdef.

Definition sf_assignability_rel (CT: class_table) (C: class_name) (f: var) (a: a) : Prop :=
  exists fdef, FieldLookup CT C f fdef /\ assignability (ftype fdef) = a.

Definition sf_mutability_rel (CT: class_table) (C: class_name) (f: var) (qf: q_f) : Prop :=
  exists fdef, FieldLookup CT C f fdef /\ mutability (ftype fdef) = qf.

Definition constructor_def_lookup (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) : option constructor_def :=
  match find_class CT C with
  | Some def => Some (constructor (body def))
  | None => None
  end.

Definition constructor_sig_lookup (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) : option constructor_sig :=
  match constructor_def_lookup CT C with
  | Some ctor => Some (csignature ctor)
  | None => None
  end.

Definition eq_method_name (m1 m2 : method_name) : bool :=
  match m1, m2 with
  | n1, n2 => Nat.eqb n1 n2
  end.

Definition gget_method (methods : list method_def) (m : method_name) : option method_def :=
  find (fun mdef => eq_method_name (mname (msignature mdef)) m) methods.

Definition override (parent_methods own_methods : list method_def) : list method_def :=
  own_methods ++ filter (fun pmdef =>
    negb (existsb (fun omdef =>
      eq_method_name (mname (msignature pmdef)) (mname (msignature omdef)))
    own_methods)) parent_methods.

Inductive CollectMethods : class_table -> class_name -> list method_def -> Prop :=

  | CM_NotFound : forall CT C
      (Hnone : find_class CT C = None),
      CollectMethods CT C []


  | CM_Object : forall CT C def
      (Hfind  : find_class CT C = Some def)
      (Hsuper : super (signature def) = None)
      (Hdom   : C < dom CT),
      CollectMethods CT C (methods (body def))


  | CM_Inherit : forall CT C def parent parent_methods own_methods merged
      (Hfind          : find_class CT C = Some def)
      (Hsuper         : super (signature def) = Some parent)
      (Hdom_C         : C < dom CT)
      (Hdom_parent    : parent < dom CT)
      (Hordering      : cname (signature def) > parent)
      (Hparent_cm     : CollectMethods CT parent parent_methods)
      (Hown_methods   : own_methods = methods (body def))
      (Hmerged        : merged = override parent_methods own_methods),
      CollectMethods CT C merged.

Definition wf_stypeuse (CT : class_table) (q_use: q) (c: class_name) : Prop :=
  match bound CT c with
  | Some q_bound =>



                  q_subtype (vpa_mutability_bound q_use q_bound) q_use /\
                   c < dom CT
  | None => False

Definition qf2q (qf : q_f) : q :=
  match qf with
  | Mut_f => Mut
  | Imm_f => Imm
  | RDM_f => RDM
  | RO_f => RO
  end.

Definition wf_field (CT : class_table) (fdef: field_def) : Prop :=
  wf_stypeuse CT (qf2q (mutability (ftype fdef)))
    (f_base_type (ftype fdef)).

Definition wf_senv (CT : class_table) (sΓ : s_env) : Prop :=

  dom sΓ > 0 /\
  Forall (fun T => wf_stypeuse CT (sqtype T) (sctype T)) sΓ.

Inductive FindMethodWithName : class_table -> class_name -> method_name -> method_def -> Prop :=

  | FOM_Here : forall CT C def own_methods m mdef
      (Hfind       : find_class CT C = Some def)
      (Hown        : own_methods = methods (body def))
      (Hget_method : gget_method own_methods m = Some mdef),

  | FOM_Super : forall CT C def parent m mdef own_methods
      (Hfind       : find_class CT C = Some def)
      (Hown        : own_methods = methods (body def))
      (Hnot_here   : gget_method own_methods m = None)
      (Hsuper      : super (signature def) = Some parent)
      (Hparent_fmn : FindMethodWithName CT parent m mdef),
      FindMethodWithName CT C m mdef.

Inductive expr_has_type : class_table -> s_env -> method_scope -> expr -> qualified_type -> Prop :=


  | ET_Null : forall CT Γ mt q class_name

      (Hdom : class_name < dom CT),

  | ET_Var : forall CT Γ mt x T
      (Hwf  : wf_senv CT Γ)
      (Hget : static_getType Γ x = Some T),
      expr_has_type CT Γ mt (EVar x) T


  | ET_Field_abstract_state : forall CT Γ mt x T fDef f
      (Hwf      : wf_senv CT Γ)
      (Hget_x   : static_getType Γ x = Some T)
      (Hfld_def : sf_def_rel CT (sctype T) f fDef)
      (Hmt      : mt = AbstractState \/ mt = ConcreteState),

  | ET_Field_readonly_state : forall CT Γ mt x T fDef f
      (Hwf      : wf_senv CT Γ)
      (Hget_x   : static_getType Γ x = Some T)
      (Hfld_def : sf_def_rel CT (sctype T) f fDef)
      (Hmt      : mt = ReadonlyState \/ mt = TransitiveState),
      expr_has_type CT Γ mt (EField x f)
        (Build_qualified_type
          (vpa_mutability_stype_fld_readonly_state (sqtype T) (mutability (ftype fDef)))
          (f_base_type (ftype fDef)))
.

Definition qc2q (qi : q_c) : q :=
  match qi with
    | RDM_c => RDM
    | Imm_c => Imm
    | Mut_c => Mut
    end.

Definition vpa_mutability_constructor_param (qc : q_c) (T : qualified_type) : qualified_type :=
  Build_qualified_type
    (vpa_mutability_qq_abstract_state (qc2q qc) (sqtype T))
    (sctype T).

Definition vpa_mutability_override (qc : q_c) (T : qualified_type) : qualified_type :=
  Build_qualified_type
    (vpa_mutability_qq_abstract_state (qc2q qc) (sqtype T))
    (sctype T).

Definition method_override_compatible
    (CT : class_table) (qc : q_c)
    (overrider overridden : method_sig) : Prop :=
  mname overrider = mname overridden /\
  mscope overrider = mscope overridden /\
  qualified_type_subtype CT
    (mret overrider)
    (vpa_mutability_override qc (mret overridden)) /\
  Forall2
    (fun overridden_param overrider_param =>
      qualified_type_subtype CT
        (vpa_mutability_override qc overridden_param)
        overrider_param)
    (mparams overridden) (mparams overrider) /\
  q_subtype
    (sqtype (vpa_mutability_override qc (mreceiver overridden)))
    (sqtype (mreceiver overrider)).

Inductive method_signature_refinement
    (CT : class_table) : method_sig -> method_sig -> Prop :=
  | msr_refl : forall msig,
      method_signature_refinement CT msig msig
  | msr_override : forall qc overrider overridden,
      bound CT (sctype (mreceiver overrider)) = Some qc ->
      base_subtype CT
        (sctype (mreceiver overrider))
        (sctype (mreceiver overridden)) ->
      wf_senv CT (mreceiver overrider :: mparams overrider) ->
      method_override_compatible CT qc overrider overridden ->
      method_signature_refinement CT overrider overridden
  | msr_trans : forall child middle parent,
      method_signature_refinement CT child middle ->
      method_signature_refinement CT middle parent ->
      method_signature_refinement CT child parent.

Definition is_nonmutable_qualifier (qualifier : q) : Prop :=

Definition signature_has_no_mutable_roots (msig : method_sig) : Prop :=
  is_nonmutable_qualifier (sqtype (mreceiver msig)) /\
  Forall

    (mparams msig).

  | [] => None
  | T_this :: _ =>

Inductive stmt_typing : class_table -> s_env -> method_scope -> stmt -> s_env -> Prop :=

  | ST_Skip : forall CT sΓ mt

  | ST_Local : forall CT sΓ mt T x sΓ'

      (Hthis    : get_this_qualified_type sΓ = Some Tthis)
      (Hnot_rcv : x <> 0)
      (Hget_x   : static_getType sΓ x = Some Tx)

  | ST_FldWrite_abstract_state : forall CT sΓ x f y Tx Ty Tthis fieldT a

      (Hget_x      : static_getType sΓ x = Some Tx)

  | ST_FldWrite_concrete_state : forall CT sΓ x f y Tx Ty Tthis fieldT a

      (Hget_x      : static_getType sΓ x = Some Tx)
      (Hget_y      : static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty)
      (Hthis       : get_this_qualified_type sΓ = Some Tthis)

      (Hassign_rel : sf_assignability_rel CT (sctype Tx) f a)
      (Hsub        : qualified_type_subtype CT Ty
                       (Build_qualified_type
                         (vpa_mutability_stype_fld_abstract_state (sqtype Tx) (mutability (ftype fieldT)))
                         (f_base_type (ftype fieldT))))
      (Hassignable : vpa_assignability_cs_ts (sqtype Tx) a = Assignable),

  cparams sig = [] /\

  exists field_defs,
    CollectFields CT c field_defs /\

    qualified_type_subtype CT

      bound CT C = Some qc ->

    (Hwf_ctor     : wf_constructor_object CT class_name cdef.(body).(constructor))
    (Hwf_fields   : Forall (wf_field CT) cdef.(body).(Syntax.fields))

    (Hsuper    : cdef.(signature).(super) = Some superC)
    (Hcname    : cdef.(signature).(cname) = thisC)
    (Hordering : thisC > superC),

    match bound CT superC with

        Forall (wf_field CT) fs

  let object_class_at_zero :=

  let class_name_matches_index :=

  non_object_classes_extend_object /\

Definition wf_constructor_object (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) (ctor : constructor_def) : Prop :=
  parent_lookup CT C = None /\
  constructor_def_lookup CT C = Some ctor /\
  let sig := csignature ctor in
  let q_c := cqualifier sig in
  Some q_c = bound CT C /\
  cparams sig = [] /\
  CollectFields CT C [].

Definition wf_constructor (CT : class_table) (c : class_name) (ctor : constructor_sig) : Prop :=

  bound CT c = Some (cqualifier ctor) /\


  Forall (fun T => wf_stypeuse CT (sqtype T) (sctype T)) (cparams ctor) /\


  exists field_defs,
    CollectFields CT c field_defs /\
    length (cparams ctor) = length field_defs /\


  Forall2 (fun param_type field_def =>
    qualified_type_subtype CT
      (vpa_mutability_constructor_param (cqualifier ctor) param_type)
      {| sqtype := vpa_mutability_constructor_fld (cqualifier ctor) (mutability (ftype field_def));
         sctype := f_base_type (ftype field_def) |})
    (cparams ctor) field_defs.

Definition wf_method (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) (mdef : method_def) : Prop :=
  let mscope := mdef.(msignature).(mscope) in
  let msig := msignature mdef in
  let methodbody := mbody mdef in
  let mbodystmt := mbody_stmt methodbody in
  let sΓ := msig.(mreceiver) :: msig.(mparams) in
  wf_stypeuse CT (sqtype (mret msig)) (sctype (mret msig)) /\
  exists sΓ' mbodyrettype,
    stmt_typing CT sΓ mscope mbodystmt sΓ' /\
    let mbodyretvar := mreturn methodbody in
    mbodyretvar < dom sΓ' /\
    nth_error sΓ' mbodyretvar = Some mbodyrettype /\
    qualified_type_subtype CT mbodyrettype (mret msig) /\
    (forall parent_def parent mdef_parent qc,
      find_class CT C = Some parent_def ->
      super (signature parent_def) = Some parent ->
      bound CT C = Some qc ->
      FindMethodWithName CT parent (mname msig) mdef_parent ->
      method_override_compatible CT qc msig (msignature mdef_parent)) /\
    sctype (mreceiver msig) = C /\
    (readonly_state_method_scope mscope ->
      signature_has_no_mutable_roots msig).

| WFObjectDef : forall CT cdef class_name
    (Hno_super    : cdef.(signature).(super) = None)
    (Hrdm         : cdef.(signature).(class_qualifier) = RDM_c)
    (Hno_fields   : cdef.(body).(Syntax.fields) = [])
    (Hno_methods  : cdef.(body).(methods) = [])
    (Hcname       : cdef.(signature).(cname) = class_name)
    (Hwf_ctor     : wf_constructor_object CT class_name cdef.(body).(constructor))
    (Hwf_fields   : Forall (wf_field CT) cdef.(body).(Syntax.fields))
    (Hnodup       : NoDup (map (fun mdef => mname (msignature mdef)) cdef.(body).(methods))),
    wf_class CT cdef

    (Hsuper    : cdef.(signature).(super) = Some superC)
    (Hcname    : cdef.(signature).(cname) = thisC)
    (Hordering : thisC > superC),
    let sig := cdef.(signature) in
    let bod := cdef.(body) in
    let C := cname sig in
    let qC := class_qualifier sig in
    (wf_constructor CT C (csignature (constructor bod)) /\
    Forall (wf_method CT C) (methods bod) /\
    NoDup (map (fun mdef => mname (msignature mdef)) (methods bod)) /\
    match bound CT superC with
    | Some q_super =>
        exists fs, CollectFields CT C fs /\
        (qC = q_super \/ q_super = RDM_c) /\
        Forall (wf_field CT) fs
    | None =>
        CollectFields CT C []
    end) ->
    wf_class CT cdef

Definition wf_class_table (CT : class_table) : Prop :=
  let object_class_at_zero :=
    exists obj_def, find_class CT 0 = Some obj_def /\
                    super (signature obj_def) = None in
  let non_object_classes_extend_object :=
    forall i def, i > 0 -> find_class CT i = Some def ->
                  super (signature def) <> None in
  let class_name_matches_index :=
    forall i def, find_class CT i = Some def ->
                  cname (signature def) = i in
  Forall (wf_class CT) CT /\
  object_class_at_zero /\
  non_object_classes_extend_object /\
  class_name_matches_index.

(* A typed frame records the receiver's runtime qualifier and types each slot. *)
Local Definition frame_typed CT h s r l ctx :=
  runtime_getVal r 0 = Some (Iot l) /\\
  r_muttype h l = Some ctx /\\
  Forall2 (value_typed CT h ctx) (vars r) s.

Local Lemma receiver_lookup r : get_this_var_mapping (vars r) =
  match runtime_getVal r 0 with Some (Iot l) => Some l | _ => None end.
Proof. destruct r as [[|[] vs]]; reflexivity. Qed.

Local Lemma receiver_type h l ctx :
  r_muttype h l = Some ctx <->
  exists rt, r_type h l = Some rt /\\ rqtype rt = ctx.
Proof.
  unfold r_muttype, r_type; destruct (runtime_getObj h l); split;
    intros; try discriminate; eauto; destruct H as [rt [Heq Hctx]];
    now inversion Heq.
Qed.

Local Lemma config_frame CT s r h :
  wf_r_config CT s r h ->
  wf_class_table CT /\\ wf_heap CT h /\\ wf_senv CT s /\\
  exists l ctx, frame_typed CT h s r l ctx.
Proof.
  intros [Hct [Hheap [[_ [[l [Hthis Hloc]] _]] [Hs [Hlen Htyping]]]]].
  repeat split; try assumption.
  - exact (proj1 Hs).
  - exact (proj2 Hs).
  - rewrite receiver_lookup in Hthis.
    destruct (runtime_getVal r 0) as [[|l']|] eqn:Hr; try discriminate.
    inversion Hthis; subst l'.
    assert (Hex : runtime_getObj h l <> None) by (apply nth_error_Some; exact Hloc).
    destruct (runtime_getObj h l) as [o|] eqn:Ho; [|contradiction].
    assert (Hctx : r_muttype h l = Some (rqtype (rt_type o)))
      by (unfold r_muttype; rewrite Ho; reflexivity).
    exists l, (rqtype (rt_type o)); repeat split; try assumption.
    apply forall2_build; [symmetry; exact Hlen|].
    intros i v T Hv HT.
    assert (Hi : i < length s) by (apply nth_error_Some; congruence).
    specialize (Htyping l _ (eq_trans (receiver_lookup r)
      ltac:(rewrite Hr; reflexivity)) Hctx i Hi T HT).
    change (runtime_getVal r i = Some v) in Hv.
    rewrite Hv in Htyping; exact Htyping.
Qed.

Local Lemma typed_value_present CT h ctx v T :
  value_typed CT h ctx v T ->
  match v with
  | Null_a => True
  | Iot l => match runtime_getObj h l with Some _ => True | None => False end
  end.
Proof.
  destruct v; simpl; auto.
  intros [rt [Hrt _]]%type_at_loc.
  destruct (rtype_exists _ _ _ Hrt) as [o [-> _]]; exact I.
Qed.

Local Lemma frame_config CT s r h l ctx :
  wf_class_table CT -> wf_heap CT h -> wf_senv CT s ->
  frame_typed CT h s r l ctx -> wf_r_config CT s r h.
Proof.
  intros Hct Hheap Hs [Hr [Hctx Hall]].
  pose proof (forall2_size _ _ _ Hall) as Hlen.
  assert (Hthis : get_this_var_mapping (vars r) = Some l)
    by (rewrite receiver_lookup Hr; reflexivity).
  unfold wf_r_config; split; [exact Hct|split; [exact Hheap|]].
  split.
  - unfold wf_renv; split.
    + apply nth_error_Some in Hr || idtac.
      assert (0 < length (vars r)) by
        (apply nth_error_Some; change (runtime_getVal r 0 <> None); congruence).
      lia.
    + split.
      * exists l; split; [exact Hthis|].
        destruct (proj1 (receiver_type _ _ _) Hctx) as [rt [Hrt _]].
        destruct (rtype_exists _ _ _ Hrt) as [o [Ho _]].
        apply nth_error_Some; change (runtime_getObj h l <> None); congruence.
      * induction Hall; constructor; eauto using typed_value_present.
  - split; [exact Hs|split; [symmetry; exact Hlen|]].
    intros l' ctx' Hl' Hctx' i Hi T HT.
    assert (l' = l) by congruence; subst l'.
    assert (ctx' = ctx) by congruence; subst ctx'.
    assert (Hsome : nth_error (vars r) i <> None) by (apply nth_error_Some; lia).
    unfold runtime_getVal; destruct (nth_error (vars r) i) as [v|] eqn:Hv;
      [|contradiction].
    exact (forall2_at _ _ _ _ _ _ Hall Hv HT).

Local Lemma frame_value CT h s r l ctx i v T :

  static_getType s i = Some T ->
  runtime_getVal r i = Some v ->
  value_typed CT h ctx v T.
Proof. intros [_ [_ Hall]] HT Hv; eapply forall2_at; eassumption. Qed.

Local Lemma frame_update CT h s r l ctx x v T :

  frame_typed CT h s (set_vars r (update x v (vars r))) l ctx.

  intros [Hr [Hctx Hall]] Hx HT Hv.
  split.
  - unfold runtime_getVal; simpl; rewrite update_other; auto.
  - split; [exact Hctx|now eapply forall2_update].

Local Lemma frame_transport CT h h' s r l ctx :
  types_preserved h h' ->
  frame_typed CT h s r l ctx -> frame_typed CT h' s r l ctx.
Proof.
  intros Hkeep [Hr [Hctx Hall]]; split; [exact Hr|split].
  - apply receiver_type in Hctx; apply receiver_type.
    destruct Hctx as [rt [Hrt Hq]]; exists rt; auto.
  - induction Hall; constructor; eauto using value_transport.
Qed.

  frame_typed CT h s r l ctx ->
  runtime_lookup_list r args = Some vals ->
  static_getType_list s args = Some Ts ->
  Forall2 (value_typed CT h ctx) vals Ts.
Proof.
  intros Hframe; unfold runtime_lookup_list, static_getType_list.
  revert vals Ts; induction args as [|a args IH]; simpl; intros vals Ts Hv HT.
  - inversion Hv; inversion HT; constructor.
  - destruct (runtime_getVal r a) as [v|] eqn:Hva;

      destruct (mapM (runtime_getVal r) args) as [vs|] eqn:Hvs;

Proof.
  intros Hsub Hfs Hfd.
  pose proof (fields_inherit _ _ _ _ _ Hsub Hfd) as Hget.
  inversion Hget as [? ? gs ? ? Hgs Hnth]; subst.
  now rewrite (fields_unique _ _ _ _ Hfs Hgs).
Qed.

Local Definition adapt_field (readonly : bool) :=
  if readonly then vpa_mutability_stype_fld_readonly_state
  else vpa_mutability_stype_fld_abstract_state.

Local Lemma read_qualifier ro ctx qr qv qs qf :
  qualifier_typable_context qr qs ctx ->
  qualifier_typable_heap qv (vpa_mutability_rec_fld qr qf) ->
  qualifier_typable_context qv (adapt_field ro qs qf) ctx.
Proof. destruct ro, ctx, qr, qv, qs, qf; simpl; tauto. Qed.

Local Lemma expr_field_value CT h s r l ctx x f lx o v T fd ro :
  wf_heap CT h -> frame_typed CT h s r l ctx ->
  static_getType s x = Some T -> sf_def_rel CT (sctype T) f fd ->
  runtime_getVal r x = Some (Iot lx) ->
  runtime_getObj h lx = Some o -> getVal (fields_map o) f = Some v ->
  value_typed CT h ctx v
    (Build_qualified_type (adapt_field ro (sqtype T) (mutability (ftype fd)))

Proof.
  intros Hheap Hframe HT Hfd Hx Ho Hv.
  pose proof (frame_value _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hframe HT Hx) as Hrecv.
  apply (type_at CT h lx o T ctx Ho) in Hrecv as [Hb Hq].
  assert (Hdom : lx < length h) by (apply nth_error_Some; change (runtime_getObj h lx <> None); congruence).
  destruct (proj1 (obj_at _ _ _ _ Ho) (Hheap _ Hdom)) as [_ [fs [Hfs [_ Hall]]]].
  pose proof (lookup_field_at _ _ _ _ _ _ Hb Hfs Hfd) as Hlookup.
  pose proof (forall2_at _ _ _ _ _ _ Hall Hv Hlookup) as Htyped.
  destruct v; [exact I|].
  destruct Htyped as [rt [Hrt [Hbase Hqual]]].
  simpl; unfold wf_r_typable; rewrite Hrt; split; simpl; eauto using read_qualifier.
Qed.

  wf_heap CT h -> frame_typed CT h s r l ctx ->
  expr_has_type CT s mt e T -> eval_expr CT r h e v OK r h ->
  value_typed CT h ctx v T.
Proof.
  intros Hheap Hframe Htyping Heval.
  inversion Htyping; subst; inversion Heval; subst; try exact I.
  - eauto using frame_value.
  - eapply (expr_field_value CT h s r l ctx x f v0 o v T0 fDef false); eassumption.
  - eapply (expr_field_value CT h s r l ctx x f v0 o v T0 fDef true); eassumption.
Qed.
